Reason (R): Article 262 empowers Parliament by law to bar the jurisdiction of the Supreme Court and other courts in inter-state river water disputes.
question.ta:

Reason (R): Article 136 confers extraordinary discretionary power on the Supreme Court to grant leave to appeal against any court or tribunal decision.
